at: he watches the machine that does not wait for uncles
alt: Blue hour on a Tang palace corridor: Chunchu at the balustrade watches lamplighters run lanterns along the terraces of the great hall
scene: 2:1 drama establishing shot, composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop. Camera at shoulder height on the roofed corridor that joins a que-tower to the hall, looking along it: SHARP DARK FOREGROUND, a vermilion column and the red-blue-green painted balustrade, and CHUNCHU from behind three-quarter, one hand on the rail, magenta silk catching warm lantern light (#D8258C). Beyond him, at true scale across the courtyard, the great double-eaved hall of the attached board on its terraces, black-grey roof with green-glazed ridge trim against a deep blue-green blue-hour sky with a last copper streak low on the horizon. Lamplighters in grey run along the terrace balustrades, lighting silk lanterns one by one so a line of gold flames is half-finished across the facade; light pours out of the hall's open doors as a hard gold backlight across the terrace, a few officials crossing it as silhouettes with long shadows toward camera. Incense haze over the courtyard turns the door light into visible shafts. Two vermilion Tang banners hang still (only a yellow sun disc). Colour contrast: gold flame highlights, cool blue-green shadows. No writing.

at: Prince Chunchu (45) approaches the Second Emperor
alt: Dawn audience inside the Tang hall: Chunchu walks up the aisle between two lines of officials, backlit by the open doors, toward the emperor's dais

Polished dark stone floor reflecting the candles and the blue doorway; incense haze makes the dawn shafts visible; lattice-shadow pattern across the floor. Colour contrast: cold blue backlight vs warm gold flame on the dais. No writing.

at: At a banquet meant to impress the Silla guest
alt: The Tang banquet: two long rows of feasting tables, dancers spinning in the centre, Taizong laughing on the dais at the head of the hall, Chunchu's cup in the foreground

Camera low on a slider at table height, OVER CHUNCHU'S SHOULDER from his low table in the guest row: sharp dark foreground of his magenta sleeve and a wine cup, warm candle on the table. No writing.
